test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following formulas is correct for Gross Value Added?

options.text: Gross Value Added = Gross National Product – Subsidies + Taxes
Gross Value Added = Gross Domestic Product – Subsidies + Taxes
Gross Value Added = Gross National Product + Subsidies – Taxes
Gross Value Added = Gross Domestic Product + Subsidies – Taxes

solution:
The correct answer is __**Gross Value Added = Gross Domestic Product + Subsidies – Taxes.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Gross value added (GVA) is determined as **output (at basic prices) minus intermediate consumption (at purchaser prices**)
 
• It is the stabilizing item of the national accounts production account. GVA can be split down by **industry and institutional sector.**
 
• Gross value added (GVA) is **an economic productivity metric that computes the particip[ation of a corporate subsidiary, company, or municipality to an economy, producer, sector, or region**. 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gross value added** measures **profits and wages of London-based businesses and London's employees.**
 
• **GVA= GDP + subsidies on products – taxes on products**.
 
 
• As the total aggregates of taxes on products and subsidies on products are only available at whole economy level, Gross value added is worked for computing **gross regional domestic product and other measures of the output** of entities smaller than an entire economy.
 
 
 
• It can also be worked to compute** how much money a product or service has contributed toward meeting a company's fixed costs.**
